verse.unicode: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਾਹੋ ॥

transliteration.english: jo jan bhaau bhagat kachh jaanai taa kau acharaj kaaho ||

en.bdb: That humble being, who knows even a little about loving devotional worship - what surprises are there for him?

verse.unicode: ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਢੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: jiau jal jal meh pais na nikasai tiau ddur milio julaaho ||1||

en.bdb: Like water, dripping into water, which cannot be separated out again, so is the weaver Kabeer, with softened heart, merged into the Lord. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਭੋਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: har ke logaa mai tau mat kaa bhoraa ||

en.bdb: O people of the Lord, I am just a simple-minded fool.

verse.unicode: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਤਜਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਮਈਐ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: jau tan kaasee tajeh kabeeraa ramieeaai kahaa nihoraa ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: If Kabeer were to leave his body at Benares, and so liberate himself, what obligation would he have to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: kahat kabeer sunahu re loiee bharam na bhoolahu koiee ||

en.bdb: Says Kabeer, listen, O people - do not be deluded by doubt.

verse.unicode: ਕਿਆ ਕਾਸੀ ਕਿਆ ਊਖਰੁ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਉ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥੩॥

transliteration.english: kiaa kaasee kiaa uookhar magahar raam ridhai jau hoiee ||2||3||

en.bdb: What is the difference between Benares and the barren land of Maghar, if the Lord is within one's heart? ||2||3||
